patches.before: The Level 2 material explains that many molds (filamentous fungi) favor warm, humid environments. Spores can also be carried by the wind, land on and invade other crops, and spread disease. Keep the preferred environment separate from the route by which they are carried. Bacteria, on the other hand, increase in number through cell division. It is important not to treat fungal spores and bacterial division as the same way of multiplying. This explanation alone cannot establish the characteristics of every pathogen or how quickly diseases spread.
patches.after: The Level 2 material explains that many molds (filamentous fungi) favor warm, humid environments. Spores can also be carried by the wind, land on and invade other crops, and spread disease. Keep the preferred environment separate from the route by which they are carried. Bacteria, also referred to as バクテリア in the Japanese material, increase in number through cell division. It is important not to treat fungal spores and bacterial division as the same way of multiplying. This explanation alone cannot establish the characteristics of every pathogen or how quickly diseases spread.
patches.reason: The Japanese explicitly teaches the alternate name バクテリア as well as division. Retain this named-term correspondence rather than omitting it in English, where 細菌 and バクテリア would otherwise collapse to the same word.

reviewNotes: All six paragraphs, six paragraph titles and lesson title/objective/activity compared directly with frozen Japanese for each locale.

Many/some examples, windborne possibility, vector versus pathogen, environmental versus vector measures, prior versus simultaneous crops, several nematode types, seasonal tendency versus fixed dates, and bacterium versus its insecticidal protein are retained.
Hindi retains both जीवाणु and बैक्टीरिया; no alias patch required. Existing terminology माहू/सूत्रकृमि and negations convey the intended bounded targets.
Both translations preserve limits on guarantees, temperature/humidity settings, exact timing, product uses and direct curing; no new prescriptions or independent question capacity introduced.
